name: Assessment start modal opens and Begin navigates to the take page
description: Clicking a Start button opens a modal describing the assessment, and clicking Begin navigates to the take page showing the first question and a progress indicator.

planSteps.description: Click the 'Start' button on the Solstice assessment card

Verify a modal dialog opens titled 'Start Solstice' that displays a question count of '36 questions', a duration of '~10 min', and the central question 'How do you burn, and which direction is your energy turning?'.
Click the 'Begin' button inside the modal
Verify the browser navigates to the Solstice take page showing a progress indicator that reads '1 of 36' and the first question prompt presented with a seven-point numbered answer scale.
